Are you looking to take your first steps in corporate accounting? An established company in the Groot-Bijgaarden region is seeking a Junior Corporate Accountant to join their team. Your Responsibilities as Junior Corporate Accountant:

Corporate Accounting for Holding & Financing Entities:

• Prepare general ledger transactions for holding and financing entities.
• Compile monthly trial balances, general ledger reconciliations, interim accounts, and statutory annual accounts.
• Collaborate with auditors to ensure accurate preparation and approval of accounts.

Treasury Management:

Process & Systems Improvement:

jobs.description:
#Talent 

 

Launch Your Career with AB InBev: Graduate Management Trainee Program 

 

What is it? 

 

Our Graduate Management Trainee (GMT) programme is a  

• 10 months program starting in August 2027 
• 3-4-month rotations within the program 
• As a junior talent, you will work on real business projects situated in Sales, Commercial, Supply & Logistics 
• You will have a 70-20-10 learning and development approach, where 70% Learning on the Job, 20% Exposure to Other, 10% Formal Learning & Training 
 

Who are we looking for? 

 

You are willing to become a future leader within AB InBev, and should be comfortable with an ambiguous career track, and expect geographic mobility. 
The following qualities describe you: Leader. Proud Owner. Agile Learner. Collaborator. Future Maker. 

 
To be eligible: 

• You must have graduated (before September 2027 and no more than two years prior) with a Bachelor's, Master's (or equivalent) degree. 
• You should also have no more than 2 years of professional experience (internships/volunteers/student jobs not included). 
• Your passion and ownership are more important than the subject you studied. 
• Fluent English is needed, as well as the native language of the country you are applying in. 
• A valid permanent visa/work permit is required in the country of application to be eligible for the programme. 
• During the 10-month program and beyond, you might be required to travel within your country of application and across Europe. 
 

We are looking for: Junior talent. Recent Graduate. Junior Manager. Professional Trainee. Graduate Trainee.

• Before you apply, check more information https://europecareers.ab-inbev.com/programmes/graduate-management-traineeship  
• Please be advised that you will only be considered for the first application you submit, therefore please make sure you are completely happy with your choice as this decision is final. 
• There is no need to upload a cover letter - this will not affect your application. 
 

Good to know 

 

• Our Graduate Management Trainee Programme is the first step to an amazing career at AB InBev. 
• Post-Programme, you will pursue a rewarding career, often within our core functions at the heart of our business within Sales, Commercial, Supply & Logistics. 
• GMT programme will give you valuable exposure and insights into leading and transforming a successful global business. You will work on real projects with senior stakeholders to drive value and undertake a structured program to support your development as a future leader. 
 

What do we offer? 

 

Next to a competitive base salary, we put our people first by providing additional benefits: 

• Learning & Development opportunities  
• Quarterly vouchers to taste our delicious beers 
• Legal holidays + Compensation & additional days (40 Days in total for fulltime employment) 
• A unique Parental leave 
• Multiple Physical & Mental Wellbeing support Initiatives 
• Meal vouchers, allowances, gift per company policy 
• Competitive Life insurance, disability & medical plan 
• A Flexible Rewards system - (smartphone, bike lease, Extra pension Plan, etc.) 
 

Where? 
  

The GMT programme is available in: 
 
¿    Belgium 
¿    France 
¿    Germany 
¿    Italy 
¿    Netherlands 
¿    United Kingdom 
  

Build your career with us 
We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities. 
 
UNIQUE CULTURE 
We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and are passionate about building upon our company's long legacy. We believe in collaboration and candor, which results in a dynamic culture with open communication. 
  
BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES 
We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites. 
  
GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES 
Our people grow at the pace of their talent. We empower our people to learn, expand their perspectives, and unlock career growth. In an environment where commitment to excellence pays off, our people are able to deepen their impact and create a long-lasting legacy.

Looking for a consolidation role with real international exposure? This industrial group based in the Brussels periphery might be the answer.

Present across several European countries with around a hundred employees on the Belgian site, the group centralises its reporting from Belgium, making the local finance department a key point of contact for all group entities.

The finance team is experienced, the tools are solid and the working environment values both autonomy and technical expertise. The offices are easily accessible by car, with parking available on site.

Your Responsibilities

You take charge of the group's consolidation process and become the reference point for intercompany financial matters. You will report directly to the manager, based in Belgium.

• Preparing and coordinating monthly and annual consolidations in accordance with IFRS standards.
• Producing consolidated reporting for the group and analysing variances.
• Monitoring IFRS developments and adapting processes accordingly.
• Supporting the accounting team during local closings.
• Coordinating with financial controllers from foreign entities and external auditors.
• Contributing to the improvement of consolidation tools and processes.

The Ideal Profile

Education : Master's degree in accounting, finance or equivalent.

Experience : Between 3 and 5 years of experience in consolidation, with a solid command of IFRS standards. Experience in a multi-entity industrial environment is a plus.

Technical skills : Advanced Excel required. Knowledge of a consolidation tool is a serious asset. Comfortable with an ERP such as SAP.

Languages : Fluent Dutch and English are essential - these are the two working languages on a daily basis.

Personal qualities

• Analytical and rigorous, you care about doing your work well.
• Comfortable with international stakeholders, you communicate clearly with both finance and non-finance profiles.
• Autonomous and structured, you manage multiple entities simultaneously without losing track.

With approximately 1,500 employees across Europe and nearly 500 employees based at its Belgian headquarters, the company continues to invest heavily in technology, innovation and international expansion. Recent developments include platform migrations, consolidation of international operations and the continued enhancement of internally developed digital products.

The legal department consists of a close-knit team of legal and regulatory specialists working collaboratively across several areas, including regulatory affairs, corporate law, commercial contracts, public affairs and employment law. The team offers a supportive environment where expertise sharing, autonomy and professional development are highly valued.

The company culture is entrepreneurial, dynamic and project-driven. Employees benefit from direct access to decision-makers, significant ownership of their responsibilities and the opportunity to contribute to strategic initiatives with tangible business impact.

• Managing license maintenance, renewals and related regulatory obligations
• Overseeing all statutory notification requirements and submissions to Dutch authorities
• Monitoring regulatory developments and assessing their impact on business activities
• Translating regulatory requirements into practical internal processes, controls and guidelines
• Providing legal advice on commercial initiatives, marketing campaigns, partnerships and new product features

• Coordinating litigation matters involving customers, business partners or authorities

• Advising on terms and conditions, promotional rules and responsible measures

• Collaborating with stakeholders across multiple countries and business functions

You will join our client's team as a strategic leader, defining and overseeing a high-impact portfolio of security initiatives, engaging senior stakeholders, and ensuring compliance with evolving regulations and cryptographic standards.
Interested?

If you are ready to shape the future of cyber security in banking and lead our client's transition to quantum-safe architectures, we would be pleased to receive your application.

• Cyber Security Strategy & Portfolio Management - Define the cyber security initiative strategy, translate it into a prioritized portfolio, and oversee cross-dependencies to deliver measurable business outcomes

• Roadmap Development & Execution - Develop long-term and short/medium-term roadmaps with clear priorities and budgets, then drive day-to-day delivery, removing impediments and ensuring adherence to master plans

• Post-Quantum Cryptography (Pqc) Knowledge - Apply strong Pqc fundamentals (e.g., lattice-based algorithms, hybrid encryption, NIST standardization) to guide cryptographic modernization and resilience

• Information Security Governance - Lead initiatives aligned with established security frameworks and risk management practices, ensuring compliance with group standards and external guidelines

• Stakeholder & Executive Engagement - Interact regularly with senior management and ExCo, aggregating input and translating complex topics like quantum risk and Pqc transition into clear, actionable memos

• Governance & Policy Contribution - Support policy improvements and the development of quantum-safe data security frameworks in collaboration with relevant teams

• Leadership & Communication - Drive success across disciplines, navigate technical uncertainty, and tailor messaging for both executives and technical teams

• Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills - Break down complex issues such as Pqc migration trade-offs, proactively addressing long-term cryptographic risks and immediate vulnerabilities

• Language Skills - French mandatory (fluent), with professional proficiency in English and Dutch

• Work Arrangement - Hybrid working model based in Brussels

jobs.occupation: Data Engineer – Passenger Flow & Platform Services 260901-JAS-001
jobs.description:
•  

Role Objective: Build, scale, and maintain the core data platform, backend applications, and REST APIs for real-time passenger timeslot services and operational capacity balancing. Act as a bridge between product owners, data scientists, and engineering teams to deliver reliable, production-grade solutions.
  

•  

Backend & API Engineering: Develop and maintain robust Python backend services and REST APIs for internal and external consumption.
  

•  

Data Pipelines & Integrations: Construct reliable data pipelines and integrations to support real-time operational workflows and capacity products.
  

•  

Cloud & Operations: Deploy, manage, and monitor applications in Azure and Kubernetes/OpenShift production environments.
  

•  

Reliability & Incident Management: Drive high availability, platform resilience, continuous improvements, and rapid troubleshooting/incident response.
  

•  

Data Science Productionization: Operationalize and scale machine learning models and data science products into production.
  

•  

Engineering Standards: Enforce CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, clean code practices, and modern software engineering standards.
  
 

•  

Mandatory Technical Experience:
 
 

•  

Backend & APIs: Strong professional experience with Python backend engineering and REST API design.
  

•  

Cloud & Containers: Hands-on deployment and management in Microsoft Azure (including Azure Database for PostgreSQL) and Kubernetes/OpenShift.
  

•  

Databases & SQL: Advanced proficiency in PostgreSQL and complex SQL querying.
  

•  

DevOps & Delivery: Production monitoring, troubleshooting, CI/CD pipeline setup, and Git workflows.
  

•  

Integration: Proven record of delivering data-intensive platforms and external-facing APIs.
  

•  

Languages: Professional fluency in 
English (team operations) and 
Dutch (stakeholder collaboration).
    

•  

Preferred Skills:
 
 

•  

Big Data: Experience with Databricks.
  

•  

Asynchronous Processing: Familiarity with Celery, RabbitMQ, or Redis.
  

•  

System Resilience: Background supporting high-availability or mission-critical enterprise environments.
